title: Zesty Crunchy German Brussels Sprouts Skillet
description: A traditional German dish featuring crispy Brussels sprouts, this recipe is a nostalgic and diabetic-friendly option, with a balance of fatty and crunchy elements. It is made with namul-blanch-season method for optimal flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and blanch them in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Cook the bacon slices in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the blanched Brussels sprouts to the skillet and cook until they are caramelized.
Add the apple cider vinegar, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
